title: Hosted runner with cost factor 6 or more
fix: Move the job to a runner you registered with gitlab-runner (tags: [your-runner-tag]) or to saas-linux-medium-amd64 (factor 2).

title: Runner size listed as Premium and Ultimate only
fix: On a Free namespace use saas-linux-small-amd64 or saas-linux-medium-amd64, or your own gitlab-runner.

title: No timeout: the 60-minute project default applies
fix: Add timeout: with the real job length, for example timeout: 15m.

title: parallel: multiplies compute minutes
fix: Lower parallel: or move the job to your own gitlab-runner.

title: retry: repeats a paid job
fix: Limit retry: to runner_system_failure, or move the job to your own gitlab-runner.

title: One job run can use the whole 400-minute Free quota
fix: Cut timeout, parallel or cost factor, or move the job to your own gitlab-runner.

title: Paid job is not interruptible
fix: Add interruptible: true so a newer pipeline can cancel it.

title: saas- tag that no hosted runner carries
fix: Use a tag from the hosted runner tables, for example saas-linux-small-amd64.

title: Untagged job runs on the small hosted runner
fix: Add tags: [your-runner-tag] to run it on your own gitlab-runner.

title: macOS or Windows hosted runner (cost factor marked Beta)
fix: Keep macOS and Windows jobs to merge requests and the default branch, or use your own gitlab-runner.
